content.comment_body: Is there a way to solve this issue? The temperature and humidity readings are showing up on the [product_name] operator device as seen in the attached image.
Consider purchasing a new device or sending the current one for repair.
Is there a solution for this issue? The temperature and humidity readings are displaying on the [product_name] operator device as shown in the photo.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please avoid posting multiple times about the same issue. Thank you.
Firstly, thank you [user_name]. Additionally, this message appears on the [product_name] CPU as seen in the photo. The issue could be related to the program.
Why didn’t you post this in the [product_name] hardware section? You might need a new [product_name].

Initially, the readings were correct. After stopping the program and checking the analog flag by pressing AM1, all modules and the CPU flashed red, then changed to green, and the readings appeared as shown in the image.

Try running another test program with messages and observe the display. If the display works correctly, re-upload your original program. Sometimes, rewriting instead of copying and pasting a program resolves issues. Some older firmware versions had problems if certain blocks exceeded specific block numbers. Regards, [user_name]
